subject: Time-sensitive: signing accelerator for Taylor Nguyen
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick — Taylor Nguyen competing offer and decision window

Team,

Heads up: Taylor (SWE-Platform finalist) just told Ben at Nimbus that she has a competing verbal from Nimbus with a faster timeline — they put a 72-hour window on her decision and are at ~10% higher base than our current band. Taylor still prefers Redwood on culture and product, but the clock is real.

What I recommend we consider to lock this: a one-time signing accelerator (one-time cash $25k), move to top of band on base, and confirm standard equity band but accelerate first-year vesting (6-month pro-rata for 25% of grant). This keeps OTE within band while increasing upfront comp.

I attached comp_band_guidelines.pdf for band ceilings. Taylor asked for an answer by EOD Friday (PST).

Ask: Rachel can you draft candidate-facing language? Lauren — do we have budget latitude for one-time payment and a short-term vesting acceleration? If not, what compromise would you accept?

Karthik

---
Attachment: comp_band_guidelines.pdf (pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — Taylor Nguyen competing offer and decision window

+1 to the accelerator option. We have some headroom in the discretionary signing pool for Q3; $25k one-time is within tolerance for a senior SWE in platform. On the vesting tweak, legal will need exact language but operationally we can do a 6-month pro-rata for up to 25% of the grant.

Two asks: 1) keep base within band (we don't change salary midpoint), 2) make the accelerator contingent on acceptance within the window to avoid precedent for retroactive payments.

If Rachel can send a candidate note today with the limited window and clear acceptance mechanics, I'll confirm sign-off with finance before you send.

Lauren
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@gmail.com>
Cc: Ben Park <ben@teamnimbus.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Updated signing package and next steps

Hi Taylor,

Thanks again for taking the time with the team last week — we really enjoyed the conversation. I wanted to be upfront: we value you highly and understand you have a quick decision to make.

Here is an updated, time-limited signing package we can offer if you elect to join Redwood within the acceptance window below:

- Base salary: top of band for Senior SWE — $190,000 (no further base uplift).
- One-time signing accelerator: $25,000 (paid on first payroll after start).
- Equity: standard grant at band midpoint; we will accelerate 25% of the grant on a 6-month pro-rata schedule (details in attached signing letter).
- Relocation/remote stipend: standard policy applies.

To accept this package we need a signed acceptance and returned signed signing_letter_Taylor_Nguyen.pdf by Friday, 13 Jul 2028 17:00 PT. The accelerator is conditional on acceptance by that deadline.

Attached: signing_letter_Taylor_Nguyen.pdf (formal offer language and vesting clause), comp_band_guidelines.pdf (internal reference).

If you'd like, we can hop on a short call today to walk through details. Ben, thanks for coordinating timing.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Recruiting Partner | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor_nguyen@gmail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Park <ben@teamnimbus.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated signing package and next steps

Thanks, Rachel — I appreciate the rapid follow-up and the revised terms. Couple quick clarifying Qs before I sign:

1) For the 25% equity acceleration, can you confirm whether that is additional to the standard four-year schedule (i.e., an extra grant), or a re-allocation of the initial grant front-loaded into the first 6 months?
2) If I accept by Friday but need to push the start date by 2 weeks for personal reasons, does that affect the accelerator payment timing or eligibility?

I prefer Redwood from everything I saw in interviews; this is mostly timing and cash availability playing into my decision. I can be on a call this afternoon if that's easier.

—Taylor

Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated signing package and next steps

Taylor — thanks for the quick questions and for flagging start-date flexibility. Answers below: 

1) The 25% acceleration is a front-loading (re-allocation) of the initial grant so there is no additional long-term equity beyond the grant you were offered; it simply moves 25% of the grant into a 6-month vesting slice. Legal has signed off on the language in the attached signing_letter_Taylor_Nguyen.pdf.

2) Start date changes of up to 2 weeks do not affect accelerator eligibility as long as acceptance and sign return are completed by the Friday 17:00 PT deadline. Payment of the one-time accelerator will happen on the first payroll following your official start.

We'd be thrilled to have you join. If those terms look good, please sign and return the attached document by the deadline and we'll confirm next steps. Happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer.

Best,
Rachel
